The job that fed it ran on Tuesdays, which was the obvious suspect and the wrong one.

The real cause was a vacuum on the jobs table that the weekly job made necessary: the queue scanned millions of dead tuples until autovacuum caught up.

We partitioned the table by week and dropped old partitions instead of deleting rows. For three years we had an outage every six weeks that nobody could explain.

The retries hid a race in our connection pool that failed one request in four hundred. Under load the retries saturated the pool and everything fell over at once.

The fix to the pool was nine lines. Removing the retries was one. A retry is a decision to not find out what went wrong; make it on purpose.","tagList":["reliability","payments"],"createdAt":"2026-09-03T09:00:00.000Z","updatedAt":"2026-09-03T09:00:00.000Z","favorited":false,"favoritesCount":2,"author":{"username":"wren","bio":"Payments infrastructure. By August, 41 percent of weekly sign-ins used one, and support tickets about locked accounts fell by half.

The hard part was not the cryptography. It was account recovery, and making sure every recovery path was as strong as the passkey it replaced.","tagList":["security","authentication"],"createdAt":"2026-09-01T15:00:00.000Z","updatedAt":"2026-09-01T15:00:00.000Z","favorited":false,"favoritesCount":2,"author":{"username":"fatima.haddad","bio":"Security engineer. You do not want two coffees. An idempotency key is how the second ask says "the same order as before".

The server stores the key with the result of the first request and returns that result to every retry. Keys expire after a day, which covers every client we have.","tagList":["payments","api-design"],"createdAt":"2026-08-11T09:00:00.000Z","updatedAt":"2026-08-11T09:00:00.000Z","favorited":false,"favoritesCount":0,"author":{"username":"wren","bio":"Payments infrastructure. Designers picked whichever looked right, engineers picked whichever was closest, and nothing lined up.

We cut to eight, named them by role (inset, stack, inline) rather than size, and wrote down when each applies. Reviews got shorter because there was less to argue about.","tagList":["design","css"],"createdAt":"2026-08-03T13:00:00.000Z","updatedAt":"2026-08-03T13:00:00.000Z","favorited":false,"favoritesCount":0,"author":{"username":"jules.moreau","bio":"Designer who ships.
